name: moses-exodus-60s
description: MOSES — EXODUS IN 60 SECONDS: a one-minute kinetic-typography reel about the biblical Moses, built with the kinetic-reel skill

scripts.encode: ${FFMPEG:-ffmpeg} -y -loglevel error -framerate 24 -i out/frames/f%05d.jpg -i assets/score.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 25 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k -shortest -movflags +faststart MOSES-EXODUS-60s.mp4
